name: Anomaly detectors
description: Optional Anomaly context and runner from a pinned detector catalogue. At Methodology it lists the data sources and detectors that fit a case; in Investigation the investigator runs a chosen detector on tables it fetched, through Anomaly's one-shot runner, and the signals become leads for the Investigation gate.
egress_note: None. The lookup reads the Anomaly checkout offline; methods run locally on read-only copies of case tables, in a child process with no keys in its environment, and Anomaly loads the tables into an in-memory DuckDB and disables external access before any method SQL runs.
risk_note: A method signal is a lead, never a finding or evidence. The catalogue is read only when its hash equals the pin above; any other catalogue hides the feature.
